info.name: BP Industrial Portal – Broker Commission APIs
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the three Broker Commission feature areas:

- **Statements** — list all statements, view detail (forecasted / current transactions), approve/reject individually or in bulk, and email an approved statement.
- **Deals** — list all deals and download an `.xlsx` export.
- **Agency** — search for broker agencies by name/contact, and retrieve the full agency dashboard (on-flow deals chart, payment history chart, agency summary metrics, agent list).

---

**Flow**
1. Run **Auth / Broker Login** — the test script extracts the JWT and stores it as `{{token}}`.
2. Every subsequent request automatically attaches `Bearer {{token}}` via the collection-level auth.
3. The **Unauthorized (401)** folder verifies that every endpoint returns `401` when no token is supplied.

> ⚠️ **Note on current auth state:** The `[Authorize(Policy = "Broker")]` attribute is currently **commented out** in all three commission controllers. Steps 1–3 above apply once auth is re-enabled. While auth is off, requests in the _Unauthorized_ folder will return `200` instead of `401`.

---

**Seed data highlights (seeded in broker-commission-*.xml)**

| Entity | ID | Status / Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Statement | `5` | PENDING — 5 Forecasted transactions |
| Statement | `32` | PENDING — 2 Forecasted transactions |
| Statement | `100` | PENDING — 2 Forecasted transactions |
| Statement | `33` | APPROVED — 1 Current transaction, has StatementEmail |
| Statement | `101` | APPROVED — 1 Current transaction, has StatementEmail |
| Statement | `4` | REJECTED |
| Agency | `1` | New Sales Agency — 64 contracts |
| Agency | `2` | Test Sales Agency 004 — 38 contracts |
| Agency | `3` | SmokeTesting215 — 31 contracts |
| Agency | `4` | Demo Agency — 20 contracts |
| Agency | `13` | TFS Energy Solutions LLC — 12 contracts |

---

**Variables**
| Variable | Default | Set by |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:5128` | Manual |
| `token` | _(empty)_ | Auto-set by Broker Login test script |

item.name: Statements
item.description:
APIs for managing broker commission statements. Each statement belongs to an agency and contains a set of transactions that can be in Forecasted or Current state.

**Status lifecycle:** `PENDING` → `APPROVED` or `REJECTED`

**Auth required:** Bearer token with `Broker` role.

request.description:
Returns summary metrics for the Statements page header cards. When called without `agencyId`, aggregates across **all** agencies.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Query params:**
| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agencyId` | string | ❌ | Scope results to a single agency. Omit to aggregate all. |

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "statementsSubmitted": 12,
  "pendingCount": 6,
  "pendingLabel": "6 pending",
  "approvedCommission": 103105.20,
  "approvedCommissionLabel": "Approved statements total",
  "approvedStatements": 4,
  "approvedStatementsLabel": "Ready for payout"
}
```

**UI mapping:**
| Card | Fields used |
|---|---|
| Statements Submitted | `statementsSubmitted`, `pendingLabel` badge |
| Approved Commission | `approvedCommission`, `approvedCommissionLabel` |
| Approved Statements | `approvedStatements`, `approvedStatementsLabel` |

> Note: The **"0 selected"** badge visible in the UI is a frontend selection state (checkboxes) — not returned by the backend.

request.description:
Approves a PENDING statement and promotes the selected transactions from **Forecasted → Current**.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statementId` | string | ✅ | ID of the PENDING statement to approve |
| `comments` | string | ❌ | Optional approval comment |
| `includedTransactionIds` | string[] | ❌ | Transaction IDs to mark as **Current**. Transactions not listed remain **Forecasted**. Pass empty array `[]` to approve with no transactions moved. |

**Business rules:**
- Statement must be in `PENDING` status. Attempting to approve an already-approved or rejected statement returns `{ success: false, message: "...not in PENDING status" }`.
- The XML is mutated on disk — call `GetStatementDetail` afterwards to verify the new state.

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Statement '5' approved successfully." }
```

> ⚠️ The seed XML has statement `5` as `PENDING`. After running this request it becomes `APPROVED`. Re-run by re-seeding or using statement `32` or `100`.

Rejects a PENDING statement and persists the rejection comments to the XML.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statementId` | string | ✅ | ID of the PENDING statement to reject |
| `comments` | string | ❌ | Rejection reason. Stored in XML and visible in GetStatementDetail. |

**Business rules:**
- Statement must be in `PENDING` status.
- Transaction states are **not** changed on rejection.
- `comments` is persisted to the XML and returned in `statementSummary.comments` on subsequent detail fetches.

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Statement '32' rejected successfully." }
```

Approves multiple PENDING statements in one call. Corresponds to the **Bulk Approve** button on the My Statements list page.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statementIds` | string[] | ✅ | One or more statement IDs. Must not be empty (400 if empty). |

**Business rules:**
- Each statement must be in `PENDING` status to be approved.
- Statements not found or not in PENDING status are reported in `message` and `success` is `false`, but the remaining valid statements are still processed.
- No `includedTransactionIds` are accepted here — bulk approve does not move transactions to Current state (the UI pattern shows Bulk Approve as a shortcut that bypasses the Include/Exclude step).

**Response (all succeeded):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "1 statement(s) approved successfully." }
```

**Response (partial failure):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Not in PENDING status: 33" }
```

> Try `"statementIds": ["100", "33"]` to see partial failure.
Verifies that sending an empty `statementIds` array returns **400 Bad Request** with a validation error from the `[MinLength(1)]` annotation on `BulkStatementRequest`.

request.description:
Sends the statement details to the email address configured in `agencyInfo.statementEmail` via MailKit (the same email service used across the portal).

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Request body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `statementId` | string | ✅ | ID of the statement to email |

**Business rules:**
- The recipient is taken from `<StatementEmail>` in the XML.
- If the field is empty or `NA`, the endpoint returns `{ success: false, message: "No statement email address is configured..." }` — no email is sent.
- SMTP must be configured in `appsettings.json` for the email to actually deliver in dev.

**Seed data note:** Statement `33` has `statementEmail = billing@tfsenergy.example.com`. Statement `5` has `NA` — use that to test the no-email-configured path.

**Response (success):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Statement #33 emailed to billing@tfsenergy.example.com." }
```

**Response (no email configured):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "No statement email address is configured for this agency." }
```

exec: pm.test('success is false when no email configured', () => pm.expect(body.success).to.be.false);
pm.test('message explains missing email', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.include('No statement email'));

request.description: Demonstrates the guard for missing `statementEmail`. Statement `5` has `<StatementEmail>NA</StatementEmail>` — the service returns `success: false` without attempting to send an email.

item.name: Deals
item.description:
APIs for viewing and exporting broker commission deals. A deal represents a commission-bearing contract between the broker and a customer.

**Auth required:** Bearer token with `Broker` role.

query.description: Optional. Filter deals to a single agency. Omit to return all. Use IDs from SearchBrokers.

request.description:
Returns commission deals scoped to the given agency. Omit `agencyId` to return all deals across all agencies.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Query params:**
| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agencyId` | string | ❌ | Scope results to a single agency (e.g. `1` = New Sales Agency). Omit to return all. |

**Seed agency IDs and deal counts:** `1` (9 deals), `13` (2 deals), `23` (2 deals), `2` (1 deal), `4` (1 deal)

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "totalEntries": 9,
  "deals": [
    {
      "companyName": "Test Comp 101",
      "contractNumber": "NA30315161259164b",
      "contractStartDate": "06/19/2016",
      "term": 12,
      "commissionPlan": "6 Months Upfront",
      "termVolume": 0.00,
      "unitFee": 0.70000,
      "currentPaymentDate": "NA",
      "currentPayment": 0.00
    }
  ]
}
```

**Note on Save View / Default View:** These column preferences are managed entirely by the UI — the backend always returns all columns.

query.description: Optional. Scope the exported file to a single agency. Omit to export all deals.

request.description:
Generates and streams a Microsoft Excel `.xlsx` file. Pass `agencyId` to export only that agency's deals.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Query params:**
| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agencyId` | string | ❌ | Filter exported rows to a single agency. Omit to include all deals. |

**Response:**
- Content-Type: `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`
- Content-Disposition: `attachment; filename=deals.xlsx`
- Body: binary `.xlsx` stream

**Columns in the exported file:**
1. Company Name
2. Contract Number
3. Contract Start Date
4. Term (Months)
5. Commission Plan
6. Term Volume
7. Unit Fee
8. Current Payment Date
9. Current Payment

**How to download in Postman:** Click **Send and Download** instead of **Send** to save the `.xlsx` file to disk.

request.description:
Returns the complete Agency Dashboard for a single agency. This is the data behind the Agency Dashboard page seen after clicking an agency in the search results.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` (Broker role)

**Query params:**
| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agencyId` | string | ✅ | The agency ID (from SearchBrokers results) |

**Response sections:**

| Section | Description |
|---|---|
| `agency` | Agency name and full address (Street, City, State, Zip) |
| `onFlowDeals` | Array of `{ month, dealCount }` — bar chart data (Month vs Deals) |
| `paymentChart` | Array of `{ month, amount, isForecasted }` — line chart data for Previous/Forecasted Payments |
| `agencySummary` | `numberOfAgents`, `numberOfDeals`, `currentPayment`, `currentPaymentPeriod`, `previousPayment`, `previousPaymentPeriod`, `forecastedPayment`, `yearToDatePayment` |

**Errors:**
- `400` — `agencyId` param missing
- `404` — no agency found with given ID

**Available agency IDs:** `1` (New Sales Agency), `2` (Test Sales Agency 004), `3` (SmokeTesting215), `4` (Demo Agency), `13` (TFS Energy Solutions LLC)
